question: Does the public national catchment geodatabase provide independent route-scale support for the Upper Kilbay–Catabangan / Lower Kilbay Catabangan cross-region name candidate?
purpose: Check whether an openly licensed modeled catchment and associated stream network can strengthen the research crosswalk while keeping official reach, boundary, and fish claims separate.

findings.evidence: The University of Glasgow research-data record offers a 128-catchment Philippine GIS geodatabase and stream-network shapefiles; its record states files are visible to anyone under CC BY 4.0. The associated 2023 peer-reviewed paper describes catchments larger than 250 km², delineated using TopoToolbox V2 from a nationwide IfSAR DEM acquired in 2013. The README says stream lines are generalized to 1 km segments.
supports: modeled stream and catchment geometry for a candidate name
doesNotSupport: official NAMRIA geometry or legal boundary
field-surveyed channel alignment, current conditions, or fish occurrence

findings.evidence: Downloaded archives from the University of Glasgow record and inspected the shapefile attributes. The catchment polygon feature New_Name=Kilbay_Catabangan reports Catch_area=270.28 km², EPSG:3857, one polygon part and 13,487 vertices. Its EPSG:3857 bounding box converts approximately to 122.524228–122.767595°E, 13.902918–14.072672°N. The matching stream-network PID has 230 generalized segments, with Strahler orders 1–4; the longest reported distance-to-outlet field is 41.555541 km.
supports: a modeled catchment and stream-network feature using the combined Kilbay_Catabangan name
a candidate geometry for internal source cross-checking
doesNotSupport: exact mapping of PAGASA upper/lower labels onto modeled segments
provincial or municipal boundary intersection without an authoritative overlay
use as a navigation, fishing access, safety, flood-warning, or public-app boundary layer

findings.evidence: DPWH Annex D-2 row 170 reports a Region V Kilbay-Catabangan principal basin of 285 km². This differs from the research geodatabase attribute (270.28 km²); the different values are source-specific model/table attributes, not surveyed boundary determinations.
supports: matching basin-name context in an official DPWH table
a documented area difference between two products
doesNotSupport: that either reported area defines a surveyed boundary
that the advisory labels identify the same delineation

findings.evidence: NAMRIA’s Information System Portal describes MarIS as a store/view/share/download platform for Hydrography Branch data, but states that access is restricted to the Hydrography Branch and NAMRIA network. The public portal does not itself provide a public download path for official geometry.
supports: the public-access limitation for this official data route
doesNotSupport: that the modeled research geometry is official

findings.evidence: Official PAGASA indexed PDF text for Region IV-A GFA No. 7 (26 November 2025) lists Upper Kilbay - Catabangan under Quezon. The live PDF endpoint returned a later notice when opened on 2026-11-01; the historic text is not reproducible from the current file at that URL.
supports: historical official upper-reach name and Quezon attribution
doesNotSupport: the exact reach geometry or equivalence with the modeled catchment

findings.evidence: Official PAGASA indexed PDF text for Region V GFA No. 8 (Final, 27 November 2025) lists Lower Kilbay Catabangan under Camarines Sur. The live PDF endpoint returned a later notice when opened on 2026-11-01; the historic text is not reproducible from the current file at that URL.
supports: historical official lower-reach name and Camarines Sur attribution
doesNotSupport: the exact reach geometry or equivalence with the Quezon upper label

catchmentBoundsWgs84Approximate.derivation: Inverse Web Mercator from the published polygon bounding box; approximate locator only.

dataExtraction.streamNetworkSegmentLength: 1 km generalized segments per dataset README

crosswalk.resolutionLevel: partial modeled catchment/name correspondence only; official route, exact advisory reach mapping, and administrative boundary remain unverified

nextActions: Request an official NAMRIA Hydrography Branch river/basin line or technical description, with datum, scale, version, and reuse terms, for the Tagkawayan–Del Gallego Kilbay-Catabangan candidate.
If official administrative geometry becomes available, compare it with the modeled catchment before describing cross-province extent or assigning advisory reaches.
Search station-resolved fish surveys separately; do not transfer species observations across this modeled basin.
nonClaims: The 270.28 km² modeled area and DPWH 285 km² principal-basin area are different source attributes, not competing surveyed boundaries.
The 2023 geodatabase is research-derived from a 2013 IfSAR DEM and is not official hydrography, a legal boundary, field-verified route, or current hazard layer.
The advisory reach labels have not been spatially assigned to the modeled stream segments.
No fish presence or absence, complete checklist, water quality, salinity, safety, access, fishing permission, or diet/bait guidance is asserted.
